scripts.dev: bun run prepare:assets && bun run prepare:agents && vite
scripts.build: bun run prepare:assets && bun run prepare:agents && vite build && bun src/cli/build-discovery.ts
scripts.assets:plan: bun run prepare:assets && bun tools/storage/publish.ts plan
scripts.assets:publish: bun run prepare:assets && bun tools/storage/publish.ts publish
scripts.assets:verify: bun run prepare:assets && bun tools/storage/publish.ts verify
scripts.prepare:agents: bun src/cli/build-agent-release.ts && bun src/cli/build-agent-distribution.ts && bun build packages/verdant-cli/cli.ts --target=node --outfile=.generated-public/agents/v1/verdant.mjs
scripts.agents:serve: bun run prepare:assets && bun run prepare:agents && bun tools/agent-runtime/local.mjs
scripts.agents:package: cd packages/verdant-cli && bun run build && npm pack --dry-run
